title: Coset averaging factors the index action on equivariant Hom complexes
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, G a group with a Fintype structure, H a subgroup with a Fintype structure, A a k-linear G-representation, and X any chain complex of k-linear G-representations indexed by the natural numbers. The representations A and the terms of X lie in the same representation universe. Form the cochain complexes U = Hom_G(X,A) and V = Hom_H(Res_H X,Res_H A), with differential given by precomposition with the differential of X. There exist k-linear cochain maps R : U → V and C : V → U such that C ∘ R = [G:H] • id_U, where • denotes repeated addition of cochain maps. Neither normality of H nor finiteness or projectivity of A or the terms of X is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (X : ChainComplex (Rep k G) ℕ), ∃ R : Quiver.Hom (X.linearYonedaObj k A) (ChainComplex.linearYonedaObj (((Rep.resFunctor H.subtype).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj X) k (Rep.res H.subtype A)), ∃ C : Quiver.Hom (ChainComplex.linearYonedaObj (((Rep.resFunctor H.subtype).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj X) k (Rep.res H.subtype A)) (X.linearYonedaObj k A), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp R C = H.index • CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (X.linearYonedaObj k A)
